question: Does SQLancer++ feedback increase successful query generation on previously unused paired seeds under a fixed database/query cap?

evidence_nodes.claim: Short feedback on/off proxy counts/traces matched in all 10 seed pairs; one operational failure in SQLancer, outside SQLancer++.
Five complete 20-database SQLancer++ seed pairs; derived successful-query-pair differences were all positive; no bug outcome was measured.
Cross-tool factorial comparison is invalid because generators/dependencies/builds differ; SQLancer++ source/build must stay pinned.
Per-database reported success rates are used to derive counts; matched caps are not matched CPU time and query yield is not defect yield.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Feedback-on consistently improves successful query-pair yield in the pinned long-horizon setup.
The prior positive result is seed-specific, measurement-sensitive, or not consistently present in fresh pairs.

gaps: exact raw pair numerator rather than derived rate
agent-level action selection and replanning outcomes

candidate_actions.action: Run preregistered seeds 4111-4115 paired feedback off/on at pinned SQLancer++ commit, SQLite 3.40.0/NoREC, 20 databases × 200 attempts; retain all raw outputs.
candidate_actions.assumptions: Planning scores are unvalidated ordinal estimates, not probabilities.

candidate_actions.action: Instrument exact successful-pair numerators and repeat under matched CPU-hours with randomized order.
candidate_actions.assumptions: Do only if A1 is directionally robust.

candidate_actions.action: Minimize, deduplicate, and independently reproduce any NoREC discrepancy; request external/maintainer confirmation separately.
candidate_actions.assumptions: No candidate discrepancy is confirmed at present.

simple_baseline_comparison.paper4_interpretation: A1 is selected for information gained per cost and immediate feasibility; these ordinal scores are planning assumptions only. There are no action-level ground-truth outcomes, so no planner performance score or expected-utility validation is claimed.

falsification_gate: If any complete fresh seed is zero/negative, or derived-rate measurement is not exact enough to support the direction, down-rank consistency. Regardless of A1, no bug-yield or agent-effectiveness claim is permitted.
